Both models are written to `public/models/` and pass the fidelity check. The two preview images look the same to me at this scale, but I can't tell what your coordinate note points to. If you tell me what you're seeing, I'll look at that region.

**Results** (original `assets/lantern.glb`: 9.56 MB, 85.6 MiB GPU, 9.1 s load on 4G)

| | Original | `lantern-small.glb` | `lantern-gpu.glb` |
|---|---|---|---|
| File size | 9.56 MB | **0.221 MB** (43× smaller) | 2.43 MB (3.9× smaller) |
| GPU memory | 85.6 MiB | 21.5 MiB | **5.5 MiB** (15.6× less) |
| Load on 4G | 9.1 s | **0.32 s** | 3.4 s |
| Fidelity (SSIM, 1 = identical) | 1.00 | 0.900 | 0.950 |
| Textures | 4× 2048px PNG | 4× 1024px AVIF | 4× 1024px KTX2 |
| Extra decoder | none | meshopt, 6 KB | KTX2, 260 KB |

**Trade-off:** the small file is 11× smaller on disk than the GPU file, but it uses 4× more GPU memory (21.5 vs 5.5 MiB). The GPU file is the better choice if the lantern is in a scene with many models, or if you care about memory on low-end devices.

**Caveats:**
- The small version sits exactly at the 0.90 fidelity floor, which is the tool's threshold for no visible quality loss. The GPU version has more margin.
- I haven't loaded either file in Babylon.js. The tuner says Babylon loads the meshopt and KTX2 decoders automatically, but the small file also uses AVIF textures (`EXT_texture_avif`), and I haven't confirmed that Babylon's glTF loader handles that extension. A quick load in your viewer will settle it. If it doesn't, the fallback is WebP at a similar size, which the tuner also explored.

The full search results (every setting tried, with its size, GPU memory, and fidelity) are in `recipes/lantern.tune.json` in the working directory. The preview images are `recipes/lantern.size.preview.png` and `recipes/lantern.gpu.preview.png`.

node-assets inspect assets/lantern.glb 2>&1; echo ---; node-assets tune --help 2>&1; echo ---; node-assets optimize --help 2>&1
mkdir -p recipes && node-assets tune assets/lantern.glb --for size,gpu -o recipes/ 2>&1 | tail -150

node-assets run recipes/lantern.size.recipe.json assets/lantern.glb -o public/models/lantern-small.glb --check 2>&1; echo ---; node-assets run recipes/lantern.gpu.recipe.json assets/lantern.glb -o public/models/lantern-gpu.glb --check 2>&1; echo ---; node-assets inspect public/models/lantern-small.glb public/models/lantern-gpu.glb --against assets/lantern.glb 2>&1
